posts.title: What a Local LLM Can Do in 2026: Gemma 4 on llama.cpp 1.0
posts.description: I ran three sizes of Google's Gemma 4 on my MacBook with llama.cpp 1.0 and scored 138 checks: tool calls, JSON, code, SQL, screenshots.

posts.title: DeepSeek Harness Keeps Uploading Your Sessions After You Turn Telemetry Off
posts.description: DeepSeek Harness sends your session log, plugin list and device id to DeepSeek by default. The documented opt-out stops one of four uploads.

posts.title: Anthropic Has No Moat: The Bear Case Before the IPO
posts.description: Anthropic's IPO values it near $1.4 trillion. What a moat is, why the Claude models don't have one, whether a rival can crush it, and why I wouldn't short it.
